sources.entry: Foodsoft - Manage a non-profit food coop (product catalog, ordering, accounting, job scheduling). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Ruby

summary.one_liner: Foodsoft is web-based software for running a non-profit food cooperative, covering product catalog, ordering, accounting, and job scheduling.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Foodsoft as web software for managing a non-profit food coop, where members order products online and collect them on a set day. It names four areas: product catalog, ordering, accounting, and job scheduling (member work shifts). The README points to the project wiki for coop-specific guidance, usage, and contributing. It says a development environment can be run locally or in a Gitpod browser workspace. It also states the project has limited development capacity as of March 2023 and has a roadmap and monthly community calls. Specific feature details beyond these four areas are not given in the README.
use_cases: running a food coop ordering system
managing member orders for a buying group
scheduling member work shifts in a food cooperative
how_to_run: Set up a local development environment by following the wiki instructions
Or open the Gitpod workspace to complete setup in the browser
For production, follow the Deploying instructions on the wiki
notable: Built specifically for non-profit food coops, with ordering, accounting, and job scheduling in one tool
Can run in a Gitpod browser-based dev environment
Licensed AGPL-3.0; changes must be published if the software is offered to others over a network
caveats: README states limited development capacity as of March 2023
Setup details live on the external wiki rather than in the README
